_llm_instructions: Populate the Responsibility Assignment Matrix (RAM) and its Key.

Responsibility Assignment Matrix.guidance: Array of assignments. The 'Work Package / Activity' is the row name, and other key-value pairs map Resource Names to their Participation Level (e.g., R, A, C, I).

Participation Key / Legend.guidance: Array defining the participation codes used in the matrix.

value.Description: Does the work to complete the task.
